examples.title: Example 1: Enabling the Keyboard Continuation
examples.description:
In this example, the onNeedSoftkeyboard API is used to enable the keyboard continuation for a button. After the keyboard is started by the text box, switch the focus to the button upon a tap. In this case, the keyboard will not collapse. Tap the text box again to continue entering text.
The onNeedSoftkeyboard API is available since API version 24.
